description: This PHP source file defines the AdministratorAccessController class, which manages administrator access control and rendering logic within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for handling pre-render setup, managing URLs, and preparing data for client-side templates.

classes.name: AdministratorAccessController
classes.description: Controller handling administrator access pages, managing pre-render logic, URL handling, and template rendering.
